name: SocialString
summary: One element of a Social string set: a single prefixed string. The member is named (`friends` or `friendInvites`), but the string's own content has no field name, so the element field stays layout-only.
purpose: Give the social string set a named element record so the container is counted(nested(...)) and the generated struct never declares a bare byte vector.

fields.name: value
fields.note: One prefix-varint length bounded to 0x2ffff and that many UTF-8 bytes, read by 0x14087a570. The single measured `friends` element is 36 zero bytes; what the string identifies (a character id, a name) is not established, so the field stays layout-only.

evidence.ref: One instance in research/fixtures/wire/state-fragment-4176.hex, 36 zero bytes; the whole body re-encodes byte-exactly through the generated codec.
